title: Servicemember Notice Days in Repossession and Collateral Recovery Sale Notices
content:
Servicemember protection term for the notice of intent to sell under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. It reads the SCRA rate-cap actions on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts (servicing records of a rate adjustment, each either a rate cap applied or a rate cap ended).

**Rule.** Where the contract carries more SCRA rate adjustments with the action rate cap applied than with the action rate cap ended, the borrower is serving and 15 days are added; where it carries at least one rate-cap-applied row and no fewer rate-cap-ended rows, the borrower has left service and 10 days are added; where it carries no rate-cap-applied row, no service days are added.

| Rate cap applied rows | Rate cap ended rows | Reading | Days added to the sale period |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | serving | 15 |
| 2 | 1 | serving | 15 |
| 1 | 1 | left service | 10 |
| 2 | 2 | left service | 10 |
| 0 | 0 | — | none |

Every rate-cap row on the contract counts, whatever its date; rows of other contracts of the same borrower do not.
